title: A worker that re-plans or drops drafts keeps operator-decision and observed-defect drafts
goal: The worker role says a draft that asks for an operator decision or describes an observed defect is never dropped by a re-plan item: it is kept and given a check, or a gate is asked

run:
import sys
t = open("agents/worker.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
ok = "operator decision" in t and "observed defect" in t
print("worker role keeps operator-decision and observed-defect drafts:", ok)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: SP-tsb23kev retrospective: ST-lhtuyih2's worker dropped 24 drafts under D-2tq4fhgs, including the operator decision ST-lgekelkq (restored by the orchestrator before landing) and six observed-defect drafts (restored by the review).
